# MeriPehli Gadi - Assam's Trusted Used Car Marketplace

> MeriPehli Gadi helps customers in Assam buy, sell, finance and insure used cars with verified listings, local support and transparent pricing.

## About

MeriPehli Gadi is a local used car marketplace focused on Assam and Northeast India. The platform connects buyers and sellers of pre-owned vehicles across 22 cities in Assam with verified listings, transparent pricing, and end-to-end support including finance, insurance, test drives, and document assistance. Powered by Shani Finserve for financing and insurance services, MeriPehli Gadi is headquartered in Dibrugarh, Assam, and serves as a trusted local alternative to national car portals.

The name "MeriPehli Gadi" translates to "My First Car" in Hindi, reflecting the brand's mission to make car ownership accessible and trustworthy for first-time buyers and families across Assam.

## Services

- Buy Used Cars in Assam — Browse verified second-hand car listings across all brands, budgets and body types
- Sell Your Car — Submit car details, get free valuation, list with photos and reach verified buyers
- Used Car Finance (Powered by Shani Finserve) — Low EMI used car loans with quick approval and minimal documentation
- Used Car Insurance (Powered by Shani Finserve) — Comprehensive, third-party and zero depreciation insurance plans
- Car Valuation — Free online car price check based on make, model, year, km driven and condition
- Test Drive Booking — Book test drives for any listed car directly through the platform
